audit.why: Ranged enchanter with a root and a shield-speed. She never dies to a walk-up she sees coming; Aatrox needs her Focused Resolve spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 phase text was a generic template that named no ultimate and no cooldown.
audit.why: Karma has Mantra (R) from level 1 on 40/38/36/34, so level 6 changes almost nothing for her. Your World Ender at 120/100/80 is the real spike in that phase.
audit.corrected: Karma has Mantra (R) from level 1, so 6 changes little for her. World Ender does: its heal amp out-drains Inner Flame chip once Focused Resolve (W, 12s) is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions described Infernal Chains (W) as a root; Riot’s text says enemies are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the zone, and the decisive interaction for this matchup was absent.
audit.why: Focused Resolve (W, 12s flat) tethers and roots if the tether is not broken — breaking range or killing the tether is what saves your commit; it also reveals stealth. Gathering Fire (P) refunds Mantra cooldown off her damage.
audit.corrected: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto her. Infernal Chains (W) drags her back to the centre if she doesn't leave the zone. Focused Resolve (W, 12s flat) roots you if the tether survives — use Umbral Dash to break range, not to chase. Vs a ranged laner save E for that, not for chip. Mantra is up from level 1 on ~40s, so read her Gathering Fire refunds, not her level.

edits.before: Ultimate interaction changes all-ins. At level 6, reassess the matchup. Aatrox gains his ultimate, but Karma's ultimate or scaling pattern may change whether you can commit.
edits.after: Karma has Mantra (R) from level 1, so 6 changes little for her. World Ender does: its heal amp out-drains Inner Flame chip once Focused Resolve (W, 12s) is down.

edits.before: Your Q sweetspot (outer edge) is your damage and your heal — land the edge, never the inner hit, and use E mid-cast to swing the sweetspot onto Karma. W (Infernal Chains) roots him if he doesn't leave the zone: use it to lock him for Q2/Q3 or to cut off his escape. Vs a ranged laner, save E to close the gap or dodge poke — not for chip damage; you only win once you're on top of him. Pop R (World Ender) for the heal, AD and move speed when you fully commit or to survive his ultimate — never burn it for a single Q.
